This should be marked as not fully testable or at least noted as an inference rather than direct observation. The 'Bell flares outward at top' checkpoint is marked as present, but the bell is partially obscured by the musician's head and the angle makes it difficult to fully verify the flare. The Router was also lenient on the 'Metal keys are silver or gold-plated' checkpoint - while some keys are visible, the image resolution and lighting make it difficult to definitively confirm the plating material. Overall, the Router was somewhat optimistic in marking all checkpoints as fully present when some are only partially verifiable.
